title: WorkItem
description: One decomposed unit of the product. Written to init/product/<id>.md (front-matter is this object). The decompose-product transition writes one or more of these.

id.description: Stable lowercase-kebab slug; the filename stem. Full words, no abbreviations (HNS-1).

summary.description: What this item delivers and why it belongs to the charter.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria — the observable conditions under which this item is complete.

depends_on.description: Ids of work items that must complete first; defines the dependency order.
